payload.title: hyp implements the shared store: one store holds many Goals
payload.body: Builds the design recorded in checkpoint-store-design:G-73R704 (selects on checkpoint-store-design-D906CD, checkpoint-store-design-HC4V9T, checkpoint-store-design-H8PJ20, checkpoint-store-design-R21S8R). Every decision is selected there with session e6a35a24 as evidence, and ADR 0020 cites those Results. The candidate is a hyp commit; go test on its base and on the candidate is the instrument. Two-Goal stores land first, so lines 2, 6 and 7 are red on that commit's parent.

why: Owner, 2026-11-11: split G1; this tree is the build (G1b). The owner writes its lines.

payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the shared-store design?

why: The build's one question; its candidate will be a hyp commit, added when one exists.
